    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PostGIS geometry(Point,4326) 经纬度与 EWKB 十六进制互相转换实战</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	
	<div class="postText">
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div>
<h1>PostGIS geometry (Point,4326) 经纬度与 EWKB 十六进制互相转换实战</h1>
</div>
<div>
<div>环境：PostgreSQL12 + PostGIS，业务表存储地震点位数据，geom 字段为原生 geometry 类型，不是 varchar 存储十六进制字符串。很多网上示例混淆 geometry 对象与 EWKB‑hex 文本，踩坑<code>Invalid endian flag value encountered</code>，本文记录完整踩坑与双向转换。</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2>一、概念区分（最容易踩坑）</h2>
</div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><strong>geometry</strong>：PostGIS 原生几何对象，数据库字段直接存这个类型，不是字符串。Navicat/DBeaver 客户端展示出来的一串 <code>0101000020E6100000...</code> 只是客户端渲染，不是真正文本字符串，不能直接拿去解析。</li>
<li><strong>EWKB‑hex</strong>：十六进制文本字符串，用于导出、接口传输；类型是 text/varchar。</li>
<li><code>decode(hex_text, 'hex')</code>：十六进制文本 → bytea 二进制。</li>
<li><code>encode(bytea, 'hex')</code>：bytea 二进制 → 可读十六进制文本。</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<div><strong>报错：Invalid endian flag value encountered.</strong></div>
</div>
<div>
<blockquote>
<div>
<div>原因：直接把 EWKB 十六进制文本字符串传给 <code>ST_GeomFromEWKB</code>，该函数入参必须是 bytea，需要先用 <code>decode()</code> 转换。</div>
</div>
</blockquote>
</div>
<div>
<h2>二、双向转换完整 SQL</h2>
</div>
<div>
<h3>2.1 经纬度 → geometry 对象（写入 geometry 字段）</h3>
</div>
<div>
<blockquote>
<div>
<div>⚠️顺序：<code>ST_MakePoint(经度lon,纬度lat)</code>，X 在前 Y 在后，不要写反！</div>
</div>
</blockquote>
</div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>-- 生成geometry点，SRID=4326 WGS84
SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(95.56, 37.80), 4326) AS geom_val;</code></pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h3>2.2 geometry 对象 → 提取经纬度</h3>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>SELECT
  ST_X(geom) AS lon,
  ST_Y(geom) AS lat
FROM mapserver_data.gsyj_lszh;</code></pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h3>2.3 geometry 对象 → EWKB 十六进制文本（导出 hex 字符串）</h3>
</div>
<div>
<blockquote>
<div>
<div>需要对外输出那串 <code>0101000020E6100000...</code> 才需要这一层</div>
</div>
</blockquote>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>SELECT encode(ST_AsEWKB(geom), 'hex') AS ewkb_hex
FROM mapserver_data.gsyj_lszh;</code></pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h3>2.4 EWKB‑hex 文本 → geometry 对象（写入 geom 字段）</h3>
</div>
<div>
<blockquote>
<div>
<div>流程：hex 文本 → decode 转 bytea → ST_GeomFromEWKB 得到 geometry 对象 → 直接存入 geom 字段</div>
</div>
</blockquote>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>SELECT ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode('0101000020E6100000C3F5285C8F525840E17A14AE47A14340','hex')) AS geom_from_hex;</code></pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2>三、业务表实战示例（地震点位表 gsyj_lszh）</h2>
</div>
<div>
<div>表关键点：</div>
</div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><code>geom</code>：public.geometry 类型，存点位</li>
<li><code>lon</code>、<code>lat</code>：float8，冗余存储经纬度</li>
<li>其他业务字段：震级、时间、人员伤亡等</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<h3>3.1 插入 SQL</h3>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>INSERT INTO "mapserver_data"."gsyj_lszh" (
    "id",
    "geom",
    "economy_wy",
    "mapname",
    "eq_date",
    "name",
    "display_name",
    "source_type",
    "eq_id",
    "location",
    "riqi",
    "m",
    "eq_date0",
    "code",
    "lon",
    "lat",
    "province",
    "collapse",
    "damage",
    "maxintensity",
    "population",
    "year",
    "gname",
    "wound",
    "hurt",
    "death",
    "intensity",
    "liedu",
    "eq_time",
    "depth",
    "economy",
    "magnitude",
    "objectid",
    "bz"
) VALUES (
    571,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(95.56, 37.80), 4326),
    '暂不详',
    'gsyj_lszh',
    '2026-06-16',
    '青海海西',
    '青海海西',
    NULL,
    0,
    '青海省海西州直辖区',
    '2026-06-16',
    6.3,
    '2026年6月16日',
    632800,
    95.56,
    37.80,
    '青海省',
    0,
    0,
    '8',
    0,
    '2026',
    '海西州直辖区',
    '0',
    '0',
    '1',
    'Ⅷ',
    '8',
    '17:06:00',
    '10',
    '暂不详',
    6.3,
    0,
    '2026/06/16,青海海西M6.3,亡1人/伤0人'
);</code></pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h3>3.2 更新 SQL（id 冲突时使用）</h3>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>UPDATE "mapserver_data"."gsyj_lszh"
SET
    geom = ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(95.56, 37.80), 4326),
    economy_wy = '暂不详',
    mapname = 'gsyj_lszh',
    eq_date = '2026-06-16',
    name = '青海海西',
    display_name = '青海海西',
    source_type = NULL,
    eq_id = 0,
    location = '青海省海西州直辖区',
    riqi = '2026-06-16',
    m = 6.3,
    eq_date0 = '2026年6月16日',
    code = 632800,
    lon = 95.56,
    lat = 37.80,
    province = '青海省',
    collapse = 0,
    damage = 0,
    maxintensity = '8',
    population = 0,
    year = '2026',
    gname = '海西州直辖区',
    wound = '0',
    hurt = '0',
    death = '1',
    intensity = 'Ⅷ',
    liedu = '8',
    eq_time = '17:06:00',
    depth = '10',
    economy = '暂不详',
    magnitude = 6.3,
    objectid = 0,
    bz = '2026/06/16,青海海西M6.3,亡1人/伤0人'
WHERE id = 571;</code></pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h3>3.3 插入后校验 SQL，核对 geom 与 lon/lat 是否一致</h3>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div dir="ltr">
<div>
<pre class="highlighter-hljs"><code>SELECT
    id,
    lon,
    lat,
    ST_X(geom) AS geom_lon,
    ST_Y(geom) AS geom_lat,
    encode(ST_AsEWKB(geom),'hex') AS geom_ewkb_hex
FROM "mapserver_data"."gsyj_lszh"
WHERE id = 571;</code></pre>
</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2>四、速查表</h2>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>业务场景</th>
<th>使用函数</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>经纬度写入 geometry 字段</td>
<td><code>ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(lng,lat),4326)</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>geometry 读取经纬度</td>
<td><code>ST_X(geom), ST_Y(geom)</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>geometry 导出 EWKB 十六进制文本</td>
<td><code>encode(ST_AsEWKB(geom),'hex')</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>EWKB‑hex 文本写入 geometry 字段</td>
<td><code>ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(hex_str,'hex'))</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2>五、避坑要点</h2>
</div>
<div>
<ol>
<li><code>ST_MakePoint(经度,纬度)</code>，顺序不能颠倒，颠倒点位会跑到地球另一边。</li>
<li><code>ST_GeomFromEWKB</code>接收 bytea，不能直接传入十六进制字符串，必须 <code>decode(xxx,'hex')</code>。</li>
<li>DBeaver/Navicat 看到 geometry 展示的十六进制，只是客户端渲染，不是 text 字符串，不能直接复制解析。</li>
<li>浮点数双精度存储，十进制小数转二进制会存在微小尾数误差，生成的 hex 字符串不一定和原始完全一致，但坐标数值几乎等价。</li>
<li>区分 2D 点和 Z/M 点，业务数据头部前缀为 <code>0101000020E6100000</code>，不要使用 <code>ST_MakePointZ</code>带高程。</li>
</ol>
</div>

</div>
